nos_units.nos_title: Plan and organize e-waste recycling operations
kus: KU1. Knowledge of e-waste categories, materials types, hazardous components, and CPCB's clarification norms for effective sorting, segregation, and operational planning.
KU2. Understanding of the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022, including compliance requirements, safety protocols, storage standards, and documentation obligations for authorised facilities.
KU3. Knowledge of resource planning principles, including assessing manpower needs, estimating weight/volume of incoming e-waste, and preparing tool/equipment checklists for daily
KU4. Understanding of workflow organisation and task allocation methods, including maintaining records, preparing contingency plans, and ensuring smooth operational flow.
KU5. Knowledge of safety standards and workspace management practices, including proper labelling, PPE requirements, hazard identification, and maintenance of approved storage
gs: GS1. Communication skills to coordinate with team members, report issues, and document daily operational activities clearly.
GS2. Numerical and analytical skills to measure weight/volume of e-waste, interpret checklists, and
GS3. Basic digital literacy to update records, use inventory tools, and access regulatory or operational information as required.

pcs.pc_description: Inspect and classify incoming e-waste by type (e.g., plastics, metals, hazardous components) for operational planning.
Evaluate the weight and volume of each e- waste category to determine processing priorities.
Identify the manpower and resource needs for daily operations, including dismantling, segregation, and recovery tasks.
Prepare checklists for required tools and equipment based on the types and quantities of e- waste.
Organize and document daily workflows and assign tasks to team members.
Assist in preparing contingency plans for potential bottlenecks or resource shortages.
Plan and coordinate the collection, transportation, and storage of e-waste, ensuring adherence to safety and environmental standards as per the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022.
Monitor team adherence to e-waste handling protocols during daily operations.
Verify that storage areas and workspaces meet safety and regulatory requirements.
Maintain records of licenses, permits, and certifications, ensuring availability for internal reviews and audits.
Report violations of safety or regulatory standards to the concerned authority for corrective action.
Demonstrate an understanding of key provisions under the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022, and other relevant Acts to guide team operations and ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.
Designate and label bins and containers for hazardous and non-hazardous materials.
Perform routine checks to ensure tools, safety kits, PPE, and materials are properly maintained and available.
Ensure workspace layout adheres to company and regulatory safety standards.
